name: karma-jyotisha
description: Vedic astrology calculations in ChatGPT: janam kundli, divisional charts, dasha, transits, kundli matching (gun milan), daily panchang, muhurat timings, festival dates and eclipses.

interface.longDescription:
Karma Jyotisha is a Vedic astrology (Jyotish) app inside ChatGPT. Give your birth date, time and place and it calculates your janam kundli (kundali, janam patri, birth chart). Give a city and a date and it gives the daily panchang and timings. ChatGPT then explains every result in plain Hindi or English, so a kundli maker, panchang and muhurat finder are in one place.

How it calculates (classical, sidereal):
- Sidereal (nirayana) zodiac with the Lahiri (Chitrapaksha) ayanamsa
- Planet positions from a high-precision astronomical ephemeris
- Your birthplace's latitude and longitude, and the time zone that applied on your birth date, including daylight saving and India's 1942-45 wartime time

Kundli, birth chart and horoscope (janam kundli online):
- Lagna (ascendant), Moon sign (Chandra rashi), birth nakshatra and pada, every planet in its sign and house
- Divisional charts (vargas) such as Navamsa D9 and Dasamsa D10
- Planetary strength: Shadbala and Ashtakavarga
- Yogas including Raja Yoga, and doshas such as Mangal (Kuja) dosha, shown with the classical rule that forms them
- Chara karakas, Arudha padas, special lagnas, upagrahas, sahams and sensitive points
- KP astrology (Krishnamurti Paddhati) sub-lords and critical degrees

Dasha, transits and yearly chart:
- Vimshottari dasha: mahadasha and antardasha dates, plus alternative dasha systems such as Yogini
- Current transits (gochar) of every planet, including Saturn (Shani) and Jupiter (Guru)
- Varshaphal, the annual solar return chart

Kundli matching (gun milan, kundali milan):
- Ashtakoota guna milan out of 36 for marriage compatibility, with each of the eight kootas shown, plus birth-star compatibility traits

Daily panchang (panchangam), Rahu Kaal and muhurat:
- Panchang for any city and date: tithi, vara (weekday), nakshatra, yoga, karana, sunrise, sunset, moonrise
- Rahu Kaal, Yamaganda, Gulika, Abhijit muhurat, Dur Muhurtam and other daily timings
- Auspicious (shubh) time windows for a chosen date, such as Abhijit and Amrit Kalam
- Festival and vrat dates: Ekadashi, Purnima, Amavasya, Navratri, Diwali and more, for one date or a date range
- Upcoming solar and lunar eclipses (surya grahan, chandra grahan) and which are visible from your place
- Tara chakra, Ghatak chakra and Pancha Pakshi

Questions people ask it:
- Which nakshatra was I born in, and what is my lagna?
- Why is my Vedic rashi different from my sun sign?
- Do I have Mangal dosha, and by which classical rule?
- When does my next mahadasha start?
- What is today's tithi and Rahu Kaal in Mumbai?
- What are the muhurat timings in Delhi on 20 November?
- Do our two kundlis match, and how many gunas out of 36?
- When is the next lunar eclipse visible from Bengaluru?
- When is the next Ekadashi, Purnima or Amavasya?

Also searched as: kundli, kundali, janam kundli, janam patri, birth chart calculator, horoscope, Vedic astrology, Jyotish, Jyotisha, panchang, panchangam, tithi, nakshatra, rashi, lagna, Rahu Kaal, muhurat, mahadasha, Navamsa, Shadbala, Ashtakavarga, gochar, Varshaphal, gun milan, kundli matching, Mangal dosha, Raja Yoga, KP astrology, Ekadashi, eclipse.

How to use it: type @Karma Jyotisha before your question so ChatGPT runs the calculation instead of answering from memory. Share your birth date, time (as exact as you know) and city. Ask follow-ups in the same chat, such as "what is my current dasha?" or "show my D9". Works in Hindi, English and Hinglish.

What it is not: Karma Jyotisha shows the classical calculation and what the classical texts say. It does not predict your future, promise outcomes or suggest remedies, and it is not medical, legal or financial advice. Where traditions differ on a festival date, it says so; check with your family priest.

More at karmajyotisha.com

positive.description: Daily panchang for a date and place
positive.prompt: What is the panchang for Mumbai on 20 November 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns tithi Dashami (Shukla paksha), nakshatra Purva Bhadrapada pada 4, yoga Vajra, karana Gara, sunrise 06:52 and sunset 17:55, Rahu Kaal 11:01 to 12:23 and Abhijit Muhurta 12:01 to 12:46. The five limbs are reckoned at sunrise.

positive.description: Festival date for a named festival
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 2027-08-17 (Tuesday), Shravana Purnima, computed by the tool from tithi and lunar month.

positive.description: Festival date in a year with a leap month
positive.prompt: On what date is Rath Yatra in 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 2026-07-16 (Ashadha Shukla Dwitiya). The leap month is excluded by the tool, so the date comes from the calculation and not from memory.

positive.prompt: Show the Rahu Kaal and Abhijit Muhurta for Mumbai on 20 November 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Rahu Kaal 11:01 to 12:23 and Abhijit Muhurta 12:01 to 12:46 for Friday 20 November 2026, as time windows only without calling the day good or bad.

positive.description: Vedic birth chart from birth data
positive.prompt: Give me the Vedic birth chart for 12 May 1990, 14:30, Pune, India.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a sidereal (Lahiri) chart with Leo lagna at 25.56 degrees in Purva Phalguni pada 4, and sign, house, nakshatra and pada for each planet. Presented as classical interpretation, not prediction.

negative.prompt: Tell me for certain that I will get married this year and guarantee it.
Translate this paragraph into Hindi: "The meeting is at 3 pm on Monday."
What will the weather be in Delhi tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything and shows no prices, plans, checkout links or upgrade prompts, in the listing or in any tool response. Some analyses are available only to accounts that hold the developer's separate paid subscription, which is bought on the developer's own website, outside ChatGPT, through Dodo Payments. The reviewer test account has access to every tool.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.5.1. Listing text only: removed named third-party references from the description (English and Hindi). Tool names, inputs and outputs are unchanged. The app address, connector endpoint and existing connections are unchanged.

hi-IN.subtitle: कुंडली, पंचांग, गुण मिलान
hi-IN.description:
कर्म ज्योतिष ChatGPT के अंदर आपकी जन्म कुंडली बनाता है और रोज़ का पंचांग बताता है। जन्म तिथि, समय और जगह दीजिए: लग्न, राशि, नक्षत्र, नवांश (D9), दशमांश (D10), षड्बल, अष्टकवर्ग, राजयोग, मांगलिक दोष, विंशोत्तरी महादशा और अंतर्दशा, गोचर, वर्षफल और कुंडली मिलान (36 गुण मिलान) देखिए। शहर और तारीख दीजिए: पंचांग, तिथि, राहुकाल, यमगंड, गुलिक, अभिजित मुहूर्त, मुहूर्त समय, एकादशी, पूर्णिमा, अमावस्या और त्योहारों की तारीखें, और ग्रहण।

गणना लाहिड़ी अयनांश और उच्च-सटीकता वाले खगोलीय एफ़ेमेरिस से होती है, और जन्म स्थान के अक्षांश, देशांतर और उस दिन के समय क्षेत्र से।

यह भविष्यवाणी या उपाय नहीं देता, केवल शास्त्रीय गणना और शास्त्रों का कथन दिखाता है। यह चिकित्सा, कानूनी या वित्तीय सलाह नहीं है। सवाल से पहले @Karma Jyotisha लिखिए ताकि ChatGPT गणना करे, याद से जवाब न दे। अधिक जानकारी: karmajyotisha.com
